purpose: Project-agnostic named governance gates with human-readable questions, explicit evidence, bounded failure routing, and terminal behavior.

evidence_contract.required_gate_slot: Every gate declares at least one evidence slot.
evidence_contract.self_acceptance: The issuer_ref must differ from observed_identity.session_ref.
evidence_contract.agent_statement_only: A statement without an independent issuer and observed identity is rejected.

validation_rules: Every gate has one human-readable name and one question ending with a question mark.
Every transition names a gate in the same graph or a declared terminal.
Every non-YES transition has failure classification, repair or review route, and terminal behavior.
NOT_APPLICABLE cannot reach COMPLETE without applicability justification evidence.
Repair cycles require positive visit limits and exceedance becomes HARD_STOP.
Gate evidence is independently identity-bound; an agent statement alone never passes.
